svg.title: Diffusion: noise is added to an image step by step by a fixed rule, and a network learns to predict that noise so it can be removed step by step
svg.text: forward: a fixed rule adds a little Gaussian noise at every step; nothing is learned
reverse: a network predicts the noise in x_t; each step removes some of it
x_t = sqrt(abar_t) x_0 + sqrt(1 - abar_t) eps, eps ~ N(0, I)
from pure noise, T steps back; DDIM: deterministic, far fewer
Noise schedule of Ho et al. 2020: beta from 1e-4 to 0.02 over T = 1000 steps; the images are computed with it.
